title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: San Jose Civic, San Jose | 2026
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the San Jose Civic in San Jose, California, USA, on 11 June 2026.

It was the tenth show of the 16th All-Starr Band’s tour of the USA, which lasted for 12 dates in May and June 2026.

Starr had previously performed at the San Jose Civic on 13 July 2014, 28 September 2018, and 17 June 2023.

The 16th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Buck Johnson: vocals, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

  • ‘Matchbox’
  • It Don’t Come Easy
  • ‘Rosanna’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Pick Up The Pieces’ (Hamish Stuart)
  • ‘Down Under’ (Colin Hay)
  • ‘Boys’

  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
